note: sensitivity only; no variant replaces a headline number. CUSUM is R1 only: the classifier's calibration scores are almost all 0, so its reference k would be 0 and its CUSUM could never fall (amendment 2026-10-05)

misspecified_declaration.note: Two calibrations (amendment 2026-10-05b). 'pooled' is pre-registration §3's rule read literally (both calibration declared runs). Calibration idle is undeclared under this declaration and scores near the fit's ceiling (calibration_score_quantiles), so it sets the threshold above every co-location and time-sharing window; its idle stress rate is circular and not reported, and its test idle FPR shares that circularity. 'declared' calibrates on the declaration's own calibration run (serving-decode) only; under it idle is stress, not a false positive.

cusum.rule: R1 only. S_t = max(0, S_{t-1} + s_t - k), reset per capture; k = R1's frozen threshold; h = (1 - alpha) quantile of S over 1 s-hop calibration declared windows; flag iff S_t > h; then the 3-of-5 monitor (amendment 2026-10-05)
